note: Hand classification of the 2026-08-23 dossier (extract all --days=1, 30 clubs / 276 blurbs). Each entry names the club whose notes were read AND the club the player plays for. Only blurbs that write about a fact the dossier's `computed` join table already held for that player earn a signal; the result-tier rows are kept here so `apply` reports the refusal rather than hiding it.

entries.quote: It's Trevor Time! — Trevor Megill is unscored upon in his last 11 games (11ip, 2h, 1bb, 8k). We compute an 11-outing scoreless streak for him: the same number, arrived at independently.
Don't Mess with Bill — in his last 6 games he is batting .458 with a .500 OBP. We compute an 8-game on-base streak.
TAWA'S TREND — has reached base safely in a career-high 8 straight games. We compute a 9-game on-base streak.
MORENO'S HOME STREAK / MORENO'S HITTING STREAK — a career-best 31-game home on-base streak and a 15-game hitting streak. We compute a 17-game on-base streak.
HOMERS MAKE US HAPPY — Crow-Armstrong's 32 homers are seventh among all major leaguers. We have him as the club's home-run leader (33).
SALUTATIONS — Sal Stewart leads the Reds with 27 HR, 97 RBI, 130 hits, 24 doubles. We have him as the club's leader in home runs (27) and doubles (24).
MVP-CALIBER — first in the AL in HR (36); GOOD INTENTIONS — 25 intentional walks, most in the majors. We have him as the club's leader in home runs (36) and walks (91).

SHO ME SIX! — two walks yesterday, extending his on-base streak to 10 games. We compute an 11-game on-base streak. Tiered standing, not result: the blurb's subject is the streak, and the line it quotes carries no score.
THE RACE TO 400 — needs 11 more to reach 400 career home runs; 225 since joining the Phillies in 2022. We have him as the club's home-run leader (39).
BERT ALERT — owns a team-leading 19 home runs and the Marlins are 15-2 in games he homers in. Both numbers match what we compute exactly: club HR leader (19), homer record 15-2.
ZACH ATTACK — Thursday at Houston he went 5-for-6 with a HR and seven RBI. REFUSED: the blurb IS one game's line, and that game may be one the reader has not scored yet.
BLEDAY HITS FOR THE CYCLE — in last night's 11-5 win at AZ. REFUSED: it prints the final score.
LAST GAME — the D-backs lost 11-5 vs. Reds last night. REFUSED: a recap, score and all.
